title: Need feedback on my AI Trading Desk
author: One-Cellist-8159
selftext:
Hi Folks,

https://i.redd.it/5whbr4xmgnwh1.png

If anyone have used edgecipher terminal recently, i am looking for the feedback. There is a link on the bottom right which says "Give Feedback". I will appreciate all positive or negative feedbacks so that i can improve the experience. 

I also wanted to briefly reiterate my vision for EdgeCipher.ai. I am developing advanced, patent-pending methods for studying financial markets and translating research into structured, transparent trade plans. My goal is not to encourage traders and investors to rely blindly on AI agents, but to use AI to improve the quality of their financial decision-making - with clear evidence, explicit assumptions, and human judgment at the center.  
  
As part of this work, I have modernized elements of the century-old Wyckoff methodology for today’s markets and are extending that approach to other established analytical methods. I aim to connect traditional market analysis with modern technology while keeping the reasoning behind each plan understandable and open to scrutiny.

  
Looking forward to make better products for the community so please provide feedback here

[https://edgecipher.ai/feedback](https://edgecipher.ai/feedback)

comments.author: QATSAlgo
comments.body:
From the description, a useful addition would be a machine-readable plan snapshot beside the explanation: data timestamp, exact trigger/invalidation, planned size and risk budget, plus the rule version. Then the trader can compare the intended decision with what actually happened rather than reviewing a narrative that changed later. I haven’t tested your terminal, so this is roadmap feedback rather than a product review.



We’re QATS. If a separate perpetuals-prop adapter is interesting, try our Trading API docs: [https://quantityproject.github.io/qats-trader-api/](https://quantityproject.github.io/qats-trader-api/) . Market data, account/risk state, orders and positions could support that plan-to-execution trace. It needs its own integration; evaluations and initial funded accounts are simulated and subject to plan rules.
